tasks.title: Marker size in the frame
tasks.statement: A marker with a side of **{s} m**, camera f = **{f} px**, altitude **{h} m**. How many pixels does the marker side span?
tasks.solution: px = f·S/H; reliable detection needs ≥ 20–30 px.

tasks.title: Descent during the latency
tasks.statement: Camera latency **{l} ms**, descent rate **{v} m/s**. How many centimeters does the vehicle drop between the frame and the response?
